meta.name: study-mindmap
meta.description: Mind-map sub-skill (orchestrated by study-assistant; also usable standalone). Use whenever a chapter knowledge-point mind map needs to be generated or refreshed — the user says "思维导图" "知识图谱" "脑图", or any knowledge point's mastery/status changed. Renders knowledge.json into a zero-dependency offline-capable interactive HTML with collapse/expand, drag/zoom, search, and mastery coloring.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将知识点自动生成可交互的思维导图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把零散知识点整理成可视化脑图
copy.tagline_en: Generate interactive mind maps from knowledge points automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn scattered knowledge into visual mind maps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据知识文件生成一个交互式 HTML 思维导图，支持节点折叠展开、拖拽缩放、搜索和高亮，并用颜色标记掌握程度。
howto.when: 当你说“思维导图”“知识图谱”“脑图”等关键词，或知识点掌握状态发生变化时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成第三章的思维导图。
say.note: Claude 会调用脚本生成对应章节的 HTML 文件。

say.text: 更新知识图谱，我刚刚复习了第二节。
say.note: Claude 会重新生成思维导图，反映最新掌握状态。
思维导图中薄弱点会以红色标记。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates an interactive HTML mind map from the knowledge file, supporting collapse/expand, drag/zoom, search, and mastery coloring.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "思维导图", "知识图谱", "脑图", or similar keywords, or when any knowledge point's mastery/status changes.

say_en.text: Generate a mind map for chapter 3.
say_en.note: Claude runs the script to produce the corresponding HTML file.

say_en.text: Update the knowledge map; I just reviewed section 2.
say_en.note: Claude regenerates the mind map reflecting the latest mastery.
Weak points are marked in red on the mind map.
